chapter_title: Concerning the Seven Works of the Living Spirit
chapter_note: This chapter is largely a compact, systematic enumeration of the Living Spirit’s cosmic “seven works” (plus an additional end-time work), in an impersonal cosmological register. The main later material is the dialogue/frame attribution at the opening and a concluding beatitude-style blessing that reads like an editorial devotional tag rather than the older expository substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: The Living Spirit has done seven [wo]rks with his strength.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the dialogue/frame attribution "[Once] again the enlightener speaks:" (hagiographic wrapper).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Initial frame formula (“Once again… speaks”) marks compilation layer; the remaining clause is the chapter’s structural incipit for the older numbered teaching sequence.

paragraphs.core_text: [The fi]rst: He brought the First Man up from the contest, the way a pearl is [brought] up from the sea.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Numbered work-list in cosmic terms (Living Spirit → First Man rescue) with internal correspondential simile (pearl/sea) and no institutional/application pivot.

paragraphs.core_text: [The second: He spread about the one who had rebelled, he crucified [h]im in every body.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the impersonal enumerative sequence; “crucified…in every body” functions as cosmological process-description rather than NT citation or church application.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: He [tr]ampled, piled up, and pierced the essences of death.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic combat/process verbs in a numbered schema; no frame, no exhortation, no institutional referents.

paragraphs.core_text: [The f]ourth: He constructed the ships of light.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Brief cosmological building-act within the fixed seven-works structure (cosmos→cosmos).

paragraphs.core_text: The fi[f]th: He evoked his five sons, and distributed them about. They [took] possession of the zone, they bore up under all the universe's weight. Also, he evoked three living words. He set [them] upon the th[re]e vessels, another one upon the giant. [Again, he evoked the] summons, that it might be mixed with the five shining men.
paragraphs.temporal_note: High-value substrate markers: structured numeration; five/three groupings; “zone,” “vessels,” “giant,” “summons” as internal cosmological mechanics without externalizing to contemporary institutions.

paragraphs.core_text: The sixth: When he had constructed the zone he aro[se] and s[e]nt forth a multitude of powers and many [angel]s; so that they would bound the circuit of the z[o]ne on every si[de], un[t]il he finished [co]nstructing the works. And at the end [of] all the [wor]ks he to[ok s]ome of them into his storehouses, and he appointed others at the watch-posts.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Administrative-cosmic ordering (storehouses, watch-posts) remains within the universe’s architecture; no ecclesial offices or paraenesis.

paragraphs.core_text: The [sev]enth: A[t the] time when the Ambass[ador dis]pl[aye]d his glorious imag[e], the L[iving] Spirit [established] many [go]ds and angels. They [ ... ] Th[ey to]ok hold of it, that the entire building [ ... ] not [ ... / ... ] one another against [the] light, which he had [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Despite lacunae, the seventh-work slot is clearly cosmological (Ambassador’s image; establishment of gods/angels; stabilizing the ‘building’ against Light).

paragraphs.core_text: Also another gr[ea]t and glorious work he will enact at the e[nd] is [the] Last [Statue], which he will bring up to the aeons of [light]; and he [ ... ] in, and [he ta]kes hold, and he smites [ ... ], and [he] builds, and he [ ... ], and he [ ... t]hem.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Eschatological-cosmic action (Last Statue; aeons of Light) remains internal to the Manichaean redemption mechanics, not NT citation or church regulation.
Beatitude-style blessing (“Blessed is he…”) reads as a devotional/editorial closure rather than the impersonal mechanical exposition typical of the oldest numbered teaching substrate.
